title: Contact-reduced care in the clinical environment through multimodal systems and robotics (ReduSys) -Testing hybrid and multimodal interaction systems at the Schön Klinik Bad Aibling
summary:
Background: Nursing care in German hospitals is facing major challenges, particularly due to the shortage of skilled staff and the increasing complexity of patient care. Robotic and digital solutions can support nursing staff and improve care. However, their development and integration in hospitals is still in its infancy and ethical standards have not yet been sufficiently clarified. In order to optimise the use of these technologies, it is important to consider the perspectives of users and the collaboration between practice and technology development.
Objectives: The project will test technologies such as the ‘Medical Smart Bed’ for contactless measurement of vital functions, the ‘Jaco®’ robotic arm,  ‘PROST’ for recording drinking, ‘Motion Capturing’ for analysing movement, the ‘FLOW’ digital care assistant and the ‘Robody’ humanoid avatar. The aim is to test their user-friendliness and potential applications in everyday clinical practice.
Methodology: The technologies are tested in clinics over a set period of time. Healthcare staff, patients and relatives can participate after giving their consent. Technology partners accompany the testing from the technical side, and clinic staff recruit the participants. After the tests, the participants complete questionnaires and in-depth interviews record ethical and social requirements.
Outlook: The results should contribute to the further development of the technologies and the development of ethical and social recommendations for their use in care.

interventions.name: After testing various technologies, healthcare staff, patients and their relatives are interviewed once using a questionnaire. In addition, in-depth interviews are conducted with potential users.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The inclusion and exclusion criteria are defined for the corresponding sub-studies.
1.Technology testing
- Nurses with one or three years of training or with a degree in nursing
- Nursing professionals in training and/or studying
- Other professional groups involved in patient care (physiotherapy, speech therapy, occupational therapy, medicine)
- Adult patients capable of giving consent
- Relatives of adult patients receiving care at the Schön Klinik Bad Aibling
- Age ≥ 18

2. retrospective assessment of ethical and social requirements for technical systems in acute inpatient care based on the Care Centered Value-Sensitive Design (CCVSD) from the user's perspective
- People who have tested at least one technical system or the overall demonstrator of the ReduSys project
Exclusion criteria:
1. Technology testing
- Persons with acute musculoskeletal complaints and illnesses as well as physical limitations (MoCap testing only)
- Persons with implanted and active medical devices as defined in Directive 90/385/EEC (AIMDD)
- Persons who have refused consent to data processing
- Persons under the age of 18
- Staff who are not involved in direct patient care
- Persons who refused to consent to data processing
- Patients unable to give consent and/or under supervision


2. retrospective assessment of ethical and social requirements for technical systems in acute inpatient care based on the Care Centered Value-Sensitive Design (CCVSD) from the user's perspective
- People who were not involved in the technology testing
